summary: Computer Science graduate with a strong foundation in backend development and hands-on experience building full-stack web applications. Proficient in Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, React, and SQL/NoSQL databases, with a passion for designing scalable, maintainable systems and solving real-world problems. Seeking a Software Engineer position where I can contribute to impactful projects while continuously growing my technical expertise.

work_experience.name: OMR - Optical Mark Recogniser (Graduation Project)
work_experience.description: AI-powered system for automated exam grading and answer sheet analysis.
highlights: Led a team of 4 developers to build an AI-powered Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) system for automated exam grading.
Designed and developed scalable backend services with NestJS, implementing JWT authentication, role-based access control, and RESTful APIs.
Integrated OpenCV and a CNN-based model to automate answer bubble detection and exam grading with high accuracy.
Built an asynchronous processing pipeline using Bull queues and a dedicated worker server to handle large batches of answer sheets without blocking API requests.
Architected the backend into dedicated application and worker services, enabling scalable background processing through Bull queues and Worker Threads.
Implemented event-driven communication between the backend and frontend, providing real-time progress updates and exam processing status.

work_experience.name: Financial Tracking System
work_experience.description: Full-stack personal finance application for tracking income, expenses, and financial activities with local database persistence.
highlights: Developed a full-stack financial tracking application using React, Express.js, Prisma ORM, and SQLite.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for managing income and expense records.
Built reusable React components and a multi-page interface for efficient financial management.
Integrated Prisma ORM with SQLite to provide reliable local data persistence and database management.

work_experience.name: Sara7a Application

work_experience.name: Gym Management System
work_experience.description: A system for managing memberships, trainers, and training sessions within the gym.
highlights: Developed responsive user interfaces for managing gym memberships, trainers, and training sessions using React and Bootstrap.
Built reusable React components and implemented client-side routing with React Router for a seamless user experience.

Collaborated with the team to integrate frontend modules with backend APIs and deliver a complete gym management solution.
